/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from werkzeug.routing import Map, Rule
from werkzeug.test import create_environ
from werkzeug.exceptions import NotFound

env = create_environ('/', 'http://foo.example.com/')

m = Map([Rule('/', endpoint='index')])
a = m.bind_to_environ(env, server_name='example.com')
assert a.subdomain == ''
assert a.match('/') == ('index', {})

m = Map([Rule('/', endpoint='index', subdomain='foo')], subdomain_matching=True)
a = m.bind_to_environ(env, server_name='example.com')
assert a.subdomain == 'foo'
assert a.match('/') == ('index', {})

m = Map([Rule('/', endpoint='index', subdomain='foo')])
a = m.bind_to_environ(env, server_name='example.com')
assert a.subdomain == ''
try:
    a.match('/')
except NotFound:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('subdomain rule matched without subdomain_matching')
PY"
